نجتبي (form VIII)
# نَجْتَبِي (najtabī) /nad͡ʒ.ta.biː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
# نَجْتَبِيَ (najtabiya) /nad͡ʒ.ta.bi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
